title: IaCSecBench: A Finding-Normalization Methodology and Reproducible Harness for Evaluating Infrastructure-as-Code Security Validation
description: Replication package and benchmark framework for evaluating Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) security validation tools across multiple abstraction levels. Includes canonical control taxonomy, mechanically admitted test corpus (56 cases), finding normalization engine, exact statistical testing suite, and raw scanner telemetry.
